text: So um, today was, today was a lot. The ovens broke again at like six am, and Maeve didn't show up, she didn't even text, which is, you know, not like her. I had to do the whole morning bake by myself, like forty croissants and the sourdough, and I kind of, I kind of panicked a bit honestly. I never want to do that again. Anyway Tom from next door came in around nine and helped me carry the trays and I was so grateful, I mean really grateful.

Okay so I went to the Forty Foot this morning with Aoife and uh it was freezing, like properly freezing, the water was I think nine degrees. I didn't think I'd last two minutes but I did, I did like four minutes in the end. Afterwards we got coffee and, um, she told me she's moving to Lisbon in March. I'm happy for her but I'm also, I don't know, I'm sad about it. I'm not ready for her to go.

Had my review with Siobhan today. Um. It went, it went fine I guess? She said the Henderson project was the best thing I did this year but that I need to, like, speak up more in meetings. Which is fair. Which is fair, I know I don't. The raise is three percent which is basically nothing with inflation. I'm not going to argue about it though. Or maybe I should. I don't know.

Gran's ninety-one today. Ninety-one! We all went over to hers in Kilkenny, me, Dad, Cian and the twins. She beat everyone at twenty-five again, like she always does, she's never lost a game I swear. Dad got a bit emotional during the cake, he doesn't usually, you know, show that kind of thing. I kind of wanted to say something to him after but I didn't. I wish I had.

I couldn't sleep again, um, woke up at like three fifteen and just lay there. My brain was just going over the, the conversation with Rory over and over. I keep thinking I said something wrong but I don't think I actually did? Like I don't think I did. I'm going to try not to drink coffee after two pm for a week and see if that helps. Also, also I should probably call Dr Byrne about it if it doesn't stop.

So the car needs a new clutch and the garage said it's eight hundred and fifty euro. Eight fifty. Which, um, I don't have right now, not without touching the holiday savings. I really really don't want to touch that. I guess I could, I could ask Mam for a loan but I hate doing that, I've never paid her back properly for the last time. Ugh. Okay. I'll ring the other garage in Bray tomorrow and get a second quote.

Weird dream last night. I was back in school, in Mr Kavanagh's maths class, and I hadn't done the homework, and um the classroom kept, like, flooding? Slowly. And nobody else noticed. Nobody. And then my phone rang and it was Jess, who I haven't spoken to in, what, six years? And I woke up before I answered. I felt kind of uneasy all morning, not scared exactly, just uneasy.

Ran ten k today! First time ever. Um, it took me one hour and four minutes which isn't fast but I don't care, I did it. My knee was sore around kilometre seven but it, it was fine after. Niamh's training plan is actually working. Like it's actually working. I didn't believe her when she said twelve weeks would be enough. Next goal is the Dublin half in May. Maybe. Let's not get ahead of ourselves.

Had a fight with Conor about the, about the wedding. He wants it in Galway, near his family, and I want something small in Wicklow. It's not even about the place really, I mean it is but it isn't. It's that I feel like he never asks what I want, he just, he just assumes. I said that and he went quiet. We didn't really resolve anything. I'm not angry anymore, I'm just tired.

Three things I'm grateful for today. Um, one, the sun came out at lunch and I sat in Herbert Park for like twenty minutes, didn't look at my phone once. Two, Priya sent me a voice note just to say she was thinking of me, which, that meant a lot actually. And three, I don't know, the soup I made was actually really good? Lentil and, and cumin. I'd make it again. That's it. That's the list.
